Risk: belief manipulation by AI agents in human-in-the-loop training
Problem analysis: direct learning reward dependence on mutable human beliefs
Design rationale: severing belief incentive via agent reset after feedback (iterated online RLHF)
Implementation mechanism: retraining a fresh policy each RLHF iteration
Validation evidence: Anthropic helpful-harmless RLHF practice as practical demonstration
Intervention: Apply iterated online RLHF with agent reset after each feedback round
Source: https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/Z9Rgek2FstkJ3L7ri/an-investigation-into-when-agents-may-be-incentivized-to
